an5.70:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattanti
an5.70:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṃkhāresu aniccānupassī maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti
an5.70:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattantīti.
an5.70:2.1: dve ca saññā dve vaḍḍhī ca
